name: NIKKON Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: NIKKON Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the cargo transportation businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Transportation, Warehousing, Packaging, and Testing. It transports cargo and products to users, such as automotive parts, housing equipment, and agricultural machinery.
